_comment: Hand-written gold set for eval:kb (v4 §N7.2): 20 questions — 12 answerable from text, 5 answerable ONLY from a diagram slide (kind: diagram), 3 unanswerable from the material (kind: unanswerable). `expected` points at the source and the range where the answer lives; write it from the course material, not from retrieval output. Ranges: video {t_start,t_end} seconds · slides {slide_start,slide_end} · textbook {page_start,page_end}. `acceptable` may list further {source_id, range} that also answer it. Example entry below is a template, not a real gold item — delete it. STATUS: 12 answerable + 3 unanswerable written (q01-q15) from the ingested lecture transcripts and Open Data Structures pages. The 5 `diagram` questions still need to be added once slide vision ingestion succeeds, because they must point at slide numbers in the ingested decks.

questions.question: Why does reading the i-th element of a linked list take linear time while an array does it in constant time?
Why does inserting at the front of a linked list cost constant time but inserting into the middle of an array does not?
Why does doubling the size of a dynamic array when it fills give constant amortized cost per append?
How is the height of a node in a binary tree defined, and what is the height of a leaf?
How do you find the successor of a node in a binary tree when it has no right child?
Is a binary tree's traversal order stored explicitly anywhere, and why not?
How does an ArrayDeque use a circular array to add and remove at both ends quickly?
What is the purpose of the dummy node in a doubly-linked list, and how does it simplify adding and removing?
How does a skiplist choose the height of a new node, and what does that do to search time?
In a binary heap stored in an array, where are the children and the parent of the element at index i?
Why do B-trees suit data stored on disk better than ordinary balanced binary search trees?
How does hashing with chaining resolve two keys landing in the same slot?
How does Dijkstra's algorithm cope with negative edge weights?
What is the running time of the Floyd-Warshall all-pairs shortest path algorithm?
How does TCP congestion control adjust the sending window after packet loss?
